purpose: Inductive bias inside Sentinel Graph-Hazard: which PhysioNet variables inform which organ-system node, and which organ systems may exchange messages. Edges constrain message passing; they are not causal claims. Learned attention weights are reported separately from these curated edges.

provenance.citation: Singer M, et al. The Third International Consensus Definitions for Sepsis and Septic Shock (Sepsis-3). JAMA. 2016;315(8):801-810.
provenance.used_for: organ systems scored by SOFA: respiratory, coagulation, hepatic, cardiovascular, renal (CNS unavailable in PhysioNet 2019)

provenance.citation: Vincent JL, et al. The SOFA score to describe organ dysfunction/failure. Intensive Care Med. 1996;22(7):707-710.
provenance.used_for: variable-to-organ assignment for platelets, bilirubin, creatinine, MAP, PaO2/FiO2 surrogates

provenance.citation: Reyna MA, et al. Early Prediction of Sepsis From Clinical Data: the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019. Crit Care Med. 2020;48(2):210-217.

Standard critical-care physiology: oxygen delivery couples cardiovascular, respiratory and haematological systems; renal and respiratory systems regulate acid-base balance; hepatic synthetic function affects coagulation.

separate_nodes.care_process: Measurement mask and time-since-measurement of every variable. Kept separate from organ nodes so the model's reliance on ordering behaviour is isolated and ablatable.
separate_nodes.context: Age, sex, ICU unit, hospital-admission time, ICU length of stay.

edges.rationale: renal perfusion depends on blood pressure
hypoperfusion and lactate in septic shock
patient context conditions every organ node
measurement behaviour is visible to every node but never merged into organ inputs
